regimes.full: all training windows of the fold
regimes.kd5: round 4's kd5 subset (fraction 0.05, seed 48, >= 1 per (subject, class))
regimes.calibration: round 4's calibration set (<= 10 per (subject, class), seed 46)

preregistration.H1: Single primary, confirmatory, no multiplicity correction: at 90%|kd5, lr 1e-3, per-subject LCI (9A protocol) averaged over seeds 0, 1, 2 (each seed pooled over folds first); paired one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank xgp_xb > lamp_recon over the 40 test subjects; supported iff p < 0.05.
preregistration.H2: At 90%|kd5, lr 1e-3, seed mean: D2 = |gap_lamp_recon| - |gap_xgp_xb|, gap = mean_older(AOPC) - mean_general(AOPC); paired stratified bootstrap (10,000, seed 42); supported iff the 95% CI of D2 > 0.
preregistration.H3: Exploratory (5 vs 13 subjects): at 90%|kd5, lr 1e-3, seed mean: D3 = wa_gap_xgp_xb - wa_gap_lamp_recon, wa_gap = mean_walking_aid(d_accuracy) - mean_other_older(d_accuracy); paired bootstrap; supported (exploratory) iff the 95% CI of D3 > 0.
preregistration.secondary_cells: the other 5 level x regime cells, lr 1e-3, seed 0: one-sided Wilcoxon on LCI, Holm over the 5
preregistration.secondary_analyses: ablations (validation first, then test, Holm over 12), seeds 1-2 on validation, both lrs, LCI sensitivity k in {5,10,20} x omega in {0.25,0.5,0.75}; none changes H1-H3
